items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:25:1
items.html: In AVI there were only three states: For the second degree, of back to face, does not apply in AVI [Aba ve Ima]. And the reason is that the two degrees, back to face and face to back, are corrected in them at once, that is, at the time of the lowering of the bottom Hey from the Einayim to the Peh, for then Bina returns to her former state, and the diminutions of the bottom Hey do not touch her at all. This is not so in ZON, where the Nukva needs two corrections for her two diminutions, as above: one for the posterior vessels, and a second for the anterior vessels. See there.
